# Operating it

<!-- generated by `python -m quality.sdk --reference`; edit the source, never this -->

Where to look when production is wrong — pointers, never copies.

- **Audit tail** — `manage.py audit_tail` prints one tenant's (or the platform's) audit trail (`apps/core/management/commands/audit_tail.py:84`)
- **Correlation id → the saved query** — `deploy/observability/queries/` holds the saved queries; the README says which answers what (`deploy/observability/README.md:1`)
- **Dead letter → replay** — `GET /dead-letters/` lists failed deliveries; `POST /dead-letters/{id}/replay/` replays one (`apps/events/api.py:553`)
- **A failed run → replay** — `POST /runs/{id}/replay/` starts a workflow run again (`apps/workflows/api.py:144`)
- **Alerts** — what each alert means and the first move (`docs/runbooks/alerts.md:1`)

Reaching a host first: [Deploying](deploying.md).
